name: tower-bosses
about: The HoH1 Forsaken Tower's six bosses (mods/campaign README, HoH1 tower): bot tower_bosses loads each boss floor (`gl mission hwp_forsaken_tower_hoh1 <i>`), starts the fight the way the level's own scripts do (its AreaTrigger's area, or its UseTrigger), lets the boss fight a god-mode player, kills it as the player until HoH1's SetBossKilled runs, then takes the exit it opens to the next floor. Clean log throughout. Needs the HoH1 import.

steps.name: the tower bosses fight and fall as in HoH1
